description: Count projects, add up their stated capacity or their disclosed investment, grouped by country, place, stage, technology, sector, developer, year (of commercial operation) or source (tracker), optionally split by stage, technology, sector or country, over any filter find_projects takes. Computed by the same engine as the site’s assistant, so the figures equal the ones /assistant gives for the same question. The units rule: capacity is added within one family only, MW, MWp and MWac as each source states them, or one other unit alone (MWh, t/yr, m3/day); MWh is never added to MW and heat (MWth) never to electricity. Every answer says how many matching projects were not counted and why (no figure in the unit, a figure its source says must not be added up, no stated year), the method in words, the trackers it rests on with their pages, and the date the newest row was read. Answers anyone: these are aggregates, as the tracker pages print them; the rows themselves are find_projects.

cod.description: Commercial operation date or range, e.g. 2027 or 2026..2028

developer.description: A developer’s company slug, e.g. acwa-power, masdar

filter.description: The /data/projects query string, as the site and its assistant take it, e.g. "place=gcc&tech=solar&stage=construction..operational&cod=2026..2028". The named fields below are added to it.

locale.description: Language of labels and method; default en

measure.description: count (default), capacity (stated, in one unit family) or investment (disclosed, USD bn)

place.description: Place slugs, comma-separated: a country (saudi-arabia, uae, oman, qatar, kuwait, bahrain, egypt, morocco, india …), a group (gcc, mena) or a province. A group matches every place within it.

sector.description: renewables, storage, data-centres, hydrogen, ccus, water

splitBy.description: One value per category per split (a stacked chart)

stage.description: A stage or a range on the lifecycle ladder, e.g. construction or tendered..operational

text.description: Free text: a project, place or company name (q=)

tracker.description: Only the rows of one tracker: saudi-renewables, saudi-captive-solar, gcc-renewables, regional-renewables, world-renewables, saudi-storage, saudi-data-centres, gcc-data-centres, regional-data-centres, world-data-centres, global-ccus, iea-hydrogen, saudi-water-register, saudi-ai-register, saudi-dedicated-systems

units.description: capacity: the units to add, e.g. ["MW"] or ["MWh"]; default the sector’s own

name: aggregate_projects
title: Count and add up projects
